svg.title: cdk-lambda-web-mcp-server
svg.desc: An MCP client talks over stdio to MCP Proxy for AWS on your computer, which signs each Streamable HTTP request with SigV4 and posts it to the IamAuth endpoint of an MCP server running as a Lambda Web Function; responses, including progress notifications, stream back as server-sent events.
